entities.name: Core Banking System
entities.definition: Core Banking System is the system of record that processes and tracks the organization's core financial transactions.
entities.business_meaning: The central platform that account balances, transfers, and statements ultimately depend on.
evidence: The Core Banking System is the system of record for all customer account balances.
All downstream reporting pulls from the Core Banking System nightly batch.

history.comment: Confirmed with platform team - this is the correct definition.

entities.name: Customer Database
entities.definition: Customer Database stores customer profile, KYC, and contact information used across banking applications.
entities.business_meaning: The authoritative store of who our customers are.
evidence: The Core Banking System uses the Customer Database to look up account holder details.

entities.name: Payment Service
entities.definition: Payment Service coordinates outbound and inbound payment processing for the payment platform.
entities.business_meaning: The service responsible for moving money between accounts and external payment networks.
evidence: The Payment Service connects to the Payment Gateway API to submit outbound transfers.
The Payments Team owns the Payment Service.

history.comment: Absorbed duplicate concept 'Payment Svc' from an older document naming convention.

entities.name: Payment Gateway API
entities.definition: Payment Gateway API is the external-facing interface used to submit and settle payment transactions.
entities.business_meaning: The door through which payment requests leave our systems and reach payment networks.
evidence: The Payment Service connects to the Payment Gateway API to submit outbound transfers.

entities.name: Payment Svc
entities.definition: Payment Svc coordinates outbound and inbound payment processing for the payment platform.
entities.business_meaning: Older document naming for the same concept as Payment Service.
evidence: The Payment Svc connects to the payment gateway to submit outbound transfers.

history.comment: Duplicate of Payment Service - merged into entity_service_payment_service.

entities.name: Legacy Reporting Service
entities.definition: Legacy Reporting Service generated nightly regulatory reports from the analytics warehouse.
entities.business_meaning: An old reporting service scheduled for decommission.
evidence: The Legacy Reporting Service references the Customer Database for account-level detail.

history.comment: This service was decommissioned last quarter - should not appear in the current ontology.

entities.name: Bank
entities.definition: Bank is mentioned in source documents but its intended meaning has not yet been confirmed.
evidence: Transfers are settled through the bank before funds are available to the customer.
The survey team noted erosion along the river bank near the data center site.

entities.name: Payments Team
entities.definition: Payments Team is the team responsible for building and operating payment processing capabilities.
entities.business_meaning: The people accountable for the Payment Service and its uptime.
evidence: The Payments Team owns the Payment Service.

entities.name: Kubernetes
entities.definition: Kubernetes is the container orchestration platform used to run banking services.
entities.business_meaning: The technology that keeps services running and scales them under load.
evidence: The Core Banking System runs its services as containers orchestrated by Kubernetes.

entities.name: PCI Compliance Policy
entities.definition: PCI Compliance Policy defines the controls required to handle cardholder data safely.
entities.business_meaning: The rules the Payment Service must follow to stay compliant.
evidence: The Payment Service implements the PCI Compliance Policy for cardholder data handling.
